title: Loopy Tiles
author: marty_sears
rules:
Rules:

Normal 6x6 sudoku rules apply.

Use the 7 types of tile shown at the top to tile the whole grid, so that a picture of a single blue loop is formed. The blue loop moves orthogonally between cells.

A digit in a circle indicates how many times that cell's tile type appears in the grid. (Tiles may not be rotated.)

If a yellow dot sits between two digits, they are non-consecutive digits. The loop may not pass through a yellow dot.
solutionCode: Digits on the loop in column 6, reading downwards
